title: funcd egress kind: flow
worker: Worker @blue
[On funcd0] red right dns: DNS forwarder | records answers nft: nftables | lateral deny, redirect [/]
gw: Egress gateway | the PEP @red check: Cedar allows? | egress::connect @purple pol: EgressPolicy | domains, CIDRs, ports @amber dest: Destination | outside funcd @gray closed: Refused | connection closed @red
